incident: The first cold health request on the Node 24 deployment timed out at the platform's 30-second limit. Subsequent requests sometimes recovered.
isolatedCause: The dedicated Prisma PostgreSQL pooled endpoint returned 'Failed to connect to upstream database. Please contact Prisma support if the problem persists.' while the direct endpoint for the same database succeeded.
changes: Prefer DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED when explicitly configured, then DATABASE_URL; do not silently override a working direct URL with DATABASE_URL_POOLED.
Remove all PostgreSQL DDL and seed writes from cold request startup. Run migrations explicitly with db:migrate.
Set connection timeout 5 seconds, query timeout 7 seconds, statement timeout 5 seconds and lock timeout 3 seconds.
Read the applied schema version for health readiness; return JSON readiness status if storage cannot respond.
liveRecovery: Pending deployment of the recovery patch; do not treat this local report as a live recovery claim.
